reviews.text:
For me, Cuore di Cane wasn't just a place where I attended a course, but a journey I'll carry with me.
Maria and Brunella, along with their team, embody everything I've found on this journey: professionalism, passion, availability, and above all, the ability to convey something that goes beyond theory.
During these months, I've learned to look at dogs with different eyes, to observe before judging, to understand their behaviors, and to question myself. But, above all, this journey has also helped me grow personally.
There have been moments of satisfaction, difficulty, anxiety, and so many emotions, but today, looking back, I'm happy I chose Cuore di Cane.
Thank you to Maria, Brunella, and their team for being part of this part of my journey.
The course is over, but what I've learned and the people I've met will stay with me.

Thank you and Forza Cani, always!

I take my setter to both daycare and training. The extensive spaces available are immersed in the nature of Vomero and are divided into different areas to offer safe activities, all fenced and extremely spacious.
The area where the dogs play and socialize is outdoors on well-maintained grass.
The staff is all qualified.
They often organize events (all interesting and aimed at raising awareness of dog ownership) in which we, the dog owners, are also encouraged to participate!
I highly recommend it.

I've been entrusting my dogs to this dog training center for over ten years, and I couldn't have made a better choice.

Professionalism, empathy, and expertise are the first words that come to mind to describe the team at this center, but in reality, there's much more: attention, listening skills, and a sincere passion for dog well-being.

I don't know anyone more qualified to whom I would entrust my lifelong companions with complete peace of mind.

We are supported by Maria, who, at every meeting, guides me with precision and patience in understanding my dogs, helping me better understand them and strengthen our relationship. Each process is built with respect, sensitivity, and great preparation.
She manages to make you understand important things without ever making you feel overwhelmed.
And the best part? You learn so much with her... but you also laugh! She knows how to make everything lighthearted, turning every meeting into a moment of growth, yes, but also fun.

The dogs' well-being always comes first, with respect and without shortcuts.

Despite the distance, you always return to a place where you feel welcomed, understood, and—why not?—even a little happier. If you have a dog, I can't recommend it enough!
Extremely careful and professional. Highly recommended.

I took my Jordan to this wonderful dog training center and he always had so much fun!!! He would come back exhausted from all the running and playing with his four-legged friends, but relaxed and joyful!!! HEART OF A DOG highly recommended for anyone who wants their dog to be HAPPY and have a full life!!!

Highly recommended!
We and our little Pacho were welcomed and advised with expertise and professionalism by the center's instructors.
The daycare and the lessons helped us tremendously to understand him and make ourselves understood, and finally our little rascal is becoming our pride and joy!
Perfect for anyone who wants to truly get to know their four-legged friend.

Paradise 💖 for those who truly love dogs🐕... a family for furry friends, and a safe place where competence, professionalism, kindness, and a deep understanding are the watchwords. It's the only place I would recommend to anyone with a furry child, because the professionals at Cuore Di Cane will treat them like part of their family.
Mokina and her friends' favorite place! 🐾🐾🐾🐾❤️❤️❤️

I took my dog ​​to the Cuore di Cane Dog Center, and I have to say it was the perfect choice! The staff were incredibly kind, first and foremost, and, no less importantly, highly qualified and professional. Whether you're looking for a few hours of fun with other dogs in a beautiful, well-maintained setting surrounded by nature, or you're looking to educate and train your dog, this center is highly recommended! Congratulations!
Great experience, Maria and Brunella are helpful and really know how to communicate and connect with our puppies. Recommended.

The entire staff is highly skilled and professional. They love and are passionate about our four-legged friends! A wonderful location. Just walk in and experience the warm welcome and serenity, and begin your journey together!

I discovered this center thanks to the recommendation of the veterinarian who has cared for my furry friends for years. I thought I had a good relationship with dogs, but thanks to them, I discovered new possibilities I hadn't even heard …

My personal experience at the Cuore di Cane dog training center focuses on training, and I'm extremely satisfied!
Welcoming and professional in a fantastic location. …

A warm welcome is what sets Cuore di Cane's comprehensive offering apart.
I found professionalism and passion both in the training and support I needed for my dogs. …
